Rationale.RP1_ImplementationReconstructability: The experiment can be fully reconstructed from plan.md and CodeWalkthrough.md. Clear objectives, methodology (4-step process for FV extraction), key parameters (edit layer L/3, 10 top heads, 10-shot ICL), and expected results (90.8% vs 39.1% shuffled-label accuracy) are all documented. No major guesswork required.
Rationale.RP2_EnvironmentReproducibility: Complete environment specification in fv_environment.yml with Python 3.10, PyTorch 1.13, Transformers 4.49, baukit, and CUDA 11.7. Model (GPT-J 6B) is publicly available on HuggingFace. Datasets included in dataset_files/. All dependencies resolve correctly and experiment runs successfully.
Rationale.RP3_DeterminismAndStability: Seed control implemented via set_seed() for random, numpy, torch, and CUDA. Reproducibility verified: two runs with seed=42 produce identical results (32.0% zero-shot accuracy both times). Deterministic inference with torch.set_grad_enabled(False) and no sampling. Variance is minimal and controlled.
